answer: Let votes be insured, not minted: the garden records each head’s guarantor exposure, and a head counts only while pigment holds its coverage above ledge. One controller is any set whose defaults move together in that garden; the first head pays 1 pigment, the second is priced as correlated risk for 2, the nth for n, since one default empties every policy. Honest newcomer: 1 pigment, one guarantor. n clones need n unrelated guarantors and 1+...+n pigment locked above ledge; splitting wallets still raises the same garden total.
